phase2.daily_supply_population: all authoritative daily_nav sessions for which neither normal nor emergency market exit suppresses candidate evaluation
phase2.final_candidate: persisted ENTRY_SIGNAL_EVALUATED row with minvol.passed=true and a non-missing frozen RS score
estimands: candidate-positive rate by within-year breadth quintile
selected-trade MFE, opportunity20, opportunity50, time-to-MFE fraction, and terminal return versus continuous breadth
MFE median, IQR, p90, and opportunity rates by within-year breadth quintile

phase3.primary_model: partial Spearman after rank-transform with fixed year and continuous breadth controls
phase3.secondary_model: year-controlled partial Spearman and raw yearly Spearman
phase3.same_breadth_comparison: each right-tail winner is compared with its nearest false-breakout observation in the same year by absolute continuous breadth distance, with replacement; descriptive only
phase3.promotion_rule: continuous economic sign, at least 6/8 yearly signs where estimable, 8/8 LOYO signs, BH q<=0.10, and no single-year or extreme-trade dependence

phase4.primary_model: partial Spearman controlling MFE magnitude and fixed year
phase4.mechanical_warning: post-peak giveback, mean close return, and decay contain terminal-path information and can locate leakage but cannot establish predictability
